bb.name: Finite State
bb.description: Design, analyze, secure, and prove connected products.

scripts.build: node --conditions=source --import tsx --input-type=module --eval "import bbPackage from '../../packages/bb-app/package.json' with { type: 'json' }; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; import { buildPluginApp, buildPluginServer, resolvePluginBuildToolchain } from '@bb/plugin-build'; const root = process.cwd(); const toolchain = await resolvePluginBuildToolchain(resolve(root, '../../node_modules/.bb-toolchain')); await buildPluginServer(root, bbPackage.version, toolchain); await buildPluginApp(root, bbPackage.version, toolchain);"
